title: CourseIR Rubric Atoms: assessment criteria become validated brain structure

claims.summary: CourseIR assessments now normalize and validate first-class rubric criteria with concept links, outcome links, and performance levels.
Compiler repair can synthesize missing rubric criteria for explicit CourseIR input while recording the repair.
Direct provider CourseIR acceptance rejects repaired or level-less rubric criteria instead of counting them as accepted direct authoring.
CourseIR projection feeds rubric criteria into enrichment surfaces and counts rubric coverage in the lesson completeness ledger.
Native authoring remains compatible with the stricter CourseIR rubric contract.

carryForward.next: Make source citations and feedback loops first-class CourseIR atoms so the compiler can prove the full curriculum chain.
Run side-by-side EduTool.dev ZIP/log audits comparing accepted direct CourseIR against native skeleton/prose fallback on the same course briefs.
